outcome.technical: R45 (_gate_derive.py): a recorded template with no {paths} word of its own (inside sh -c quoting, or --x={paths}) is filled by literal substitution again. point_shape takes a literal branch when no command has a located slot: every path without by_kind, and with by_kind the paths its one mode takes. New helpers: _placeholder_modes (re-reads a quoted word as an entry of its own, so the command inside the quoting decides the mode), _literal_mode, and _literal_slot (reads a filled entry back by the template's text around {paths}). _shape_modes uses the literal mode, so taken_paths and slot_takes_sources agree with the fill; slot_reading reads a literally filled entry back by its text, so untaken_slot_paths still names a document written into the slot. point_shape now answers [] only when by_kind leaves no path, which is also how it treats a located slot. OPTION_ARGUMENT_WORDS = _ARGUMENT_TAKING_WORDS - _BARE_IN_SOME_RUNNER({-w vitest watch, -o jest onlyChanged, -e jest expand}), so a word behind one of these is positional and narrows as before.
